compatibilityIssues: Migration from Web Forms to .NET 8 required
upgradeSteps: Refactor Web Forms to Razor Pages/MVC

issues.impact: All data access code must be rewritten. Entity configurations, LINQ queries, and database initialization must be migrated to EF Core patterns.
issues.description: The project uses Entity Framework 6.2.0 which is NOT compatible with .NET 8. EF6 is a .NET Framework-only package and cannot be migrated to .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace EntityFramework 6.2.0 with Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 8.0.0, and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design 8.0.0. Migrate DbContext from System.Data.Entity.DbContext to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Update all entity configurations from EntityTypeConfiguration to IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Replace HasRequired/WithMany with HasOne/WithMany.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6.2.0 - Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: Complete rewrite of DbContext and all entity configurations required.
issues.description: The CatalogDBContext class inherits from System.Data.Entity.DbContext which does not exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace 'using System.Data.Entity;' with 'using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;'. Change DbContext base class to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Update OnModelCreating to use ModelBuilder instead of DbModelBuilder.
issues.title: System.Data.Entity Namespace Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: All entity configurations must be rewritten to use EF Core fluent API patterns.
issues.description: EntityTypeConfiguration<T> pattern used in CatalogDBContext is not available in EF Core 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> interface from Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders. Create separate configuration classes for each entity implementing IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Use builder.ApplyConfiguration() in OnModelCreating.
issues.title: EntityTypeConfiguration Not Available in EF Core

issues.impact: All logging code must be refactored. Logging configuration moved from XML to code-based configuration.
issues.description: The project uses log4net 2.0.10 which is a legacy logging framework not recommended for .NET 8 applications.
issues.recommendation: Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging (built-in) or Serilog.AspNetCore 8.0.0. Replace ILog with ILogger<T>. Configure logging in Program.cs using builder.Logging or Serilog. Remove log4Net.xml configuration file. Update all logging statements to use structured logging patterns.
issues.title: log4net 2.0.10 - Legacy Logging Not Recommended for .NET 8

issues.codeSnippet:
using log4net;
private static readonly ILog _log = LogManager.GetLogger(...)
issues.impact: All classes using logging must be refactored to use dependency injection and ILogger<T>.
issues.description: Usage of log4net ILog throughout the application code (Global.asax.cs, Default.aspx.cs, etc.) is not compatible with modern .NET 8 logging.
issues.recommendation: Replace 'using log4net;' with 'using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;'. Replace ILog with ILogger<T>. Inject ILogger<T> via constructor. Update all _log.Debug/Info/Error calls to use _logger.LogDebug/LogInformation/LogError with structured logging.
issues.title: ILog from log4net Not Compatible with .NET 8 Patterns

issues.impact: Complete application rewrite required. All Web Forms pages must be migrated to Razor Pages or MVC.
issues.description: The project has extensive dependencies on System.Web which is not available in .NET 8. This is a .NET Framework-only assembly.
issues.recommendation: Remove System.Web reference entirely. Migrate to ASP.NET Core. Replace HttpContext.Current with IHttpContextAccessor. Replace Session with distributed cache or TempData. Replace Server.MapPath with IWebHostEnvironment. Replace Cache with IMemoryCache.
issues.title: System.Web Dependency - Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: All session state usage must be redesigned. Consider moving to stateless JWT-based authentication.
issues.description: Global.asax.cs uses HttpContext.Current which is not available in ASP.NET Core/.NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Refactor to use IHttpContextAccessor injected via dependency injection. Replace Session storage with distributed cache (IDistributedCache) or TempData in ASP.NET Core. Consider whether session data is still needed - modern stateless design is preferred.
issues.title: HttpContext.Current Pattern Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: Complete application startup redesign required. All initialization logic must be moved to Program.cs.
issues.description: Global.asax with Application_Start, Session_Start, Application_BeginRequest events is a Web Forms pattern that doesn't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Migrate Application_Start logic to Program.cs in .NET 8. Migrate routing to endpoint routing. Migrate bundling to modern asset management (LibMan, npm, webpack). Migrate DI configuration to builder.Services. Migrate Application_BeginRequest to middleware pipeline.
issues.title: Global.asax Application Events Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: Dependency injection configuration must be rewritten for ASP.NET Core.
issues.description: Autofac.Integration.Web 4.0.0 is designed for Web Forms and is not compatible with ASP.NET Core/.NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove Autofac.Web package. If continuing with Autofac, use Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection 8.0.0 for ASP.NET Core integration. However, consider using built-in ASP.NET Core DI container which is sufficient for most scenarios. Migrate IContainerProviderAccessor pattern to standard DI.
issues.title: Autofac.Integration.Web - Web Forms Specific Package

issues.codeSnippet: <%@ Page Title="Home Page" Language="C#" MasterPageFile="~/Site.Master" AutoEventWireup="true" CodeBehind="Default.aspx.cs" Inherits="eShopLegacyWebForms._Default" %>
issues.impact: All UI pages must be completely rewritten. Server controls replaced with HTML helpers/Tag Helpers.
issues.description: 7 .aspx Web Forms pages found. Web Forms is not available in .NET 8 and must be completely rewritten.
issues.recommendation: Migrate all .aspx pages to Razor Pages (.cshtml with PageModel) or MVC Views. Default.aspx → Pages/Index.cshtml. Create.aspx → Pages/Catalog/Create.cshtml. Edit.aspx → Pages/Catalog/Edit.cshtml. Details.aspx → Pages/Catalog/Details.cshtml. Delete.aspx → Pages/Catalog/Delete.cshtml. Replace code-behind with PageModel classes.
issues.title: ASP.NET Web Forms Pages (.aspx) Not Supported in .NET 8

issues.impact: All UI markup must be rewritten. Data binding syntax completely different.
issues.description: Web Forms server controls (asp:ListView, asp:HyperLink, asp:TextBox, asp:DropDownList, asp:Button, etc.) are not available in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace server controls with HTML + Razor syntax. asp:ListView → @foreach loop with HTML table. asp:HyperLink → <a asp-page> tag helpers. asp:TextBox → <input asp-for> tag helpers. asp:DropDownList → <select asp-for asp-items> tag helpers. asp:Button → <button type="submit">.
issues.title: Server Controls Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: All layout structure must be migrated to Razor Layout pattern.
issues.description: Site.Master and Site.Mobile.Master files use Web Forms Master Page pattern which doesn't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Migrate Master Pages to Razor Layout pages (_Layout.cshtml). Replace ContentPlaceHolder with @RenderBody() and @RenderSection(). Create Pages/Shared/_Layout.cshtml. Update all pages to use @{ Layout = "_Layout"; }.
issues.title: Master Pages Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: All page logic must be refactored from event-driven to request handler pattern.
issues.description: Web Forms page lifecycle events (Page_Load, Page_PreRender, IsPostBack) are fundamental to Web Forms but don't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Migrate Page_Load logic to Razor Pages OnGet/OnGetAsync handler methods. Replace IsPostBack checks with separate OnGet and OnPost handler methods. Migrate route data access to [FromRoute] parameters or RouteData property in PageModel. Remove event-driven patterns in favor of HTTP verb-based handlers.
issues.title: Page Lifecycle Events Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: State management approach must be completely redesigned.
issues.description: Web Forms ViewState mechanism for maintaining state across postbacks doesn't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace ViewState with hidden form fields for necessary state. Use [BindProperty] on PageModel properties. Use TempData for temporary cross-request data. Consider stateless design where possible. Store IDs in route parameters instead of ViewState.
issues.title: ViewState Pattern Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: All form submission logic must be refactored to HTTP POST handlers.
issues.description: Web Forms postback event handlers (OnClick, OnTextChanged, etc.) are not supported in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace event handlers with Razor Pages OnPost/OnPostAsync handler methods. Rename Save_Click to OnPostAsync. Use form submission with method="post". Remove EventArgs parameters. Use [BindProperty] for form fields instead of FindControl pattern.
issues.title: Postback Event Handlers Not Available in .NET 8

issues.codeSnippet:
<asp:RequiredFieldValidator runat="server" ControlToValidate="Name" Display="Dynamic"
    CssClass="field-validation-valid text-danger" ErrorMessage="The Name field is required." />
issues.impact: Validation logic must be moved to model attributes and validation libraries.
issues.description: ASP.NET Web Forms validation controls (RequiredFieldValidator, RangeValidator) don't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace server validation controls with Data Annotations on model properties ([Required], [Range], [StringLength]). Use asp-validation-for tag helpers in views. Implement FluentValidation for complex scenarios. Add client-side validation with jQuery Validation. Use ModelState.IsValid in handlers.
issues.title: Server-Side Validation Controls Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: DbContext initialization pattern completely different in EF Core.
issues.description: CatalogDBContext inherits from System.Data.Entity.DbContext which is EF6-specific and not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Change to inherit from Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Replace constructor connection string pattern 'base("name=ConnectionString")' with DbContextOptions<T> pattern. Configure connection string in Program.cs using builder.Services.AddDbContext. Update to use dependency injection.
issues.title: System.Data.Entity.DbContext Base Class Not Available

issues.impact: All relationship configurations must be updated to EF Core fluent API.
issues.description: HasRequired/WithMany relationship configuration pattern is EF6-specific and not available in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace HasRequired with HasOne in EF Core. Update to: builder.HasOne<CatalogBrand>(ci => ci.CatalogBrand).WithMany().HasForeignKey(ci => ci.CatalogBrandId). Review delete behavior as EF Core defaults differ from EF6.
issues.title: EF6 Relationship Configuration API Not Available

issues.impact: Database initialization strategy must be migrated to EF Core migrations.
issues.description: EF6 Database.SetInitializer pattern used in Global.asax.cs doesn't exist in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove Database.SetInitializer. Use EF Core migrations instead of database initializers. Run migrations in Program.cs startup: using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope()) { var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<CatalogDBContext>(); db.Database.Migrate(); }. Seed data in OnModelCreating with HasData method.
issues.title: Database.SetInitializer Pattern Not Available in EF Core

issues.impact: Asset bundling and minification must be reconfigured for ASP.NET Core.
issues.description: Bundling and minification packages for Web Forms are not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization. Use modern asset management: WebOptimizer.Core 3.0.x for server-side bundling/minification, or LibMan/npm for client-side asset management. Use link and script tag helpers with asp-append-version for cache busting.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: URL routing must be reconfigured using ASP.NET Core routing.
issues.description: FriendlyUrls package is Web Forms-specific and not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove Microsoft.AspNet.FriendlyUrls. Use ASP.NET Core endpoint routing with route templates in PageModel [Route] attributes or MapRazorPages configuration. Configure friendly URLs using route constraints and custom route handlers.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.FriendlyUrls Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.codeSnippet:
<package id="AspNet.ScriptManager.bootstrap" version="4.3.1" targetFramework="net472" />
<package id="AspNet.ScriptManager.jQuery" version="3.3.1" targetFramework="net472" />
issues.impact: Client-side library management must be reconfigured.
issues.description: ScriptManager packages for Web Forms are not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove ScriptManager packages. Use LibMan or npm to manage client-side libraries (Bootstrap, jQuery). Reference scripts directly in _Layout.cshtml. Use tag helpers for script inclusion: <script src="~/lib/jquery/dist/jquery.min.js"></script>.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.ScriptManager Packages Not Compatible

issues.impact: All dependency injection must be refactored to constructor injection.
issues.description: Property injection pattern used in code-behind files (public ICatalogService CatalogService { get; set; }) is Web Forms/Autofac-specific.
issues.recommendation: Replace property injection with constructor injection in PageModel classes. Create constructor: public IndexModel(ICatalogService catalogService) { _catalogService = catalogService; }. Remove Autofac property injection configuration. Use standard ASP.NET Core DI.
issues.title: Property Injection Pattern Not Supported in ASP.NET Core

issues.impact: Data binding approach completely different in Razor Pages.
issues.description: Web Forms data binding pattern with DataBind() method doesn't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove DataBind() calls. In Razor Pages, pass data through PageModel properties marked with [BindProperty]. Access properties directly in view: @Model.Data. Use @foreach loops instead of ListView. Razor automatically renders bound data without explicit DataBind call.
issues.title: DataBind() Method Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: Route parameter access must be updated to ASP.NET Core patterns.
issues.description: Web Forms Page.RouteData.Values access pattern differs from ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with PageModel method parameters: public async Task OnGetAsync(int size = 10, int index = 0). Use [FromRoute] attribute if needed. Or access via RouteData.Values in PageModel. Remove Page.RouteData references.
issues.title: RouteData.Values Access Pattern Different

issues.codeSnippet: PaginationNext.NavigateUrl = GetRouteUrl("ProductsByPageRoute", new { index = Model.ActualPage + 1, size = Model.ItemsPerPage });
issues.impact: URL generation must use ASP.NET Core link generation.
issues.description: Web Forms GetRouteUrl helper method for generating URLs doesn't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with IUrlHelper or tag helpers. In views use: <a asp-page="/Index" asp-route-index="@(Model.ActualPage + 1)" asp-route-size="@Model.ItemsPerPage">. In PageModel use: Url.Page("/Index", new { index = Model.ActualPage + 1, size = Model.ItemsPerPage }).
issues.title: GetRouteUrl Helper Not Available

issues.impact: All configuration must be migrated to JSON-based configuration.
issues.description: Web.config file is .NET Framework-specific and is not used in .NET 8 applications.
issues.recommendation: Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json. Migrate connectionStrings to appsettings.json ConnectionStrings section. Migrate appSettings to root level properties. Configure in Program.cs. HTTP modules/handlers migrate to middleware.
issues.title: Web.config Not Used in .NET 8

issues.impact: EF configuration moved to code-based setup in Program.cs.
issues.description: The entityFramework configuration section in Web.config is EF6-specific.
issues.recommendation: Remove entityFramework section. Configure EF Core in Program.cs: builder.Services.AddDbContext<CatalogDbContext>(options => options.UseSqlServer(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("CatalogDBContext")));
issues.title: EntityFramework Configuration Section Not Used in EF Core

issues.impact: All HTTP modules must be rewritten as middleware.
issues.description: HTTP modules configured in Web.config (Autofac, TelemetryCorrelation, etc.) are not supported in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace HTTP modules with ASP.NET Core middleware. Create custom middleware classes implementing IMiddleware or use inline middleware with app.Use(). Register in middleware pipeline in Program.cs. Replace Autofac modules with standard DI configuration.
issues.title: HTTP Modules Not Supported in .NET 8

issues.impact: Session configuration must be code-based in Program.cs.
issues.description: Session state configuration in Web.config must be migrated to ASP.NET Core pattern.
issues.recommendation: Configure session in Program.cs: builder.Services.AddDistributedMemoryCache(); builder.Services.AddSession(options => { options.IdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30); }); app.UseSession();. Consider distributed cache for scalability (Redis, SQL Server).
issues.title: Session State Configuration Different in .NET 8

issues.impact: All redirects must use ASP.NET Core redirect methods.
issues.description: Web Forms Response.Redirect is used which should be replaced with ASP.NET Core redirect patterns.
issues.recommendation: Replace Response.Redirect with RedirectToPage in PageModel handlers: return RedirectToPage("/Index"); or return RedirectToPage("/Catalog/Index"); with route values if needed.
issues.title: Response.Redirect Pattern Should Use RedirectToPage

issues.impact: Minor syntax change in validation checks.
issues.description: Web Forms ModelState pattern (this.ModelState.IsValid) differs from ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: In Razor Pages, access ModelState without 'this' qualifier: if (ModelState.IsValid). ModelState validation works with Data Annotations on model properties. Use [BindProperty] on PageModel properties for automatic model binding and validation.
issues.title: ModelState Access Pattern Different

issues.impact: All user controls must be migrated to Razor components.
issues.description: ViewSwitcher.ascx user control must be migrated to Razor partial views or view components.
issues.recommendation: Migrate user controls to Razor partial views (_ViewSwitcher.cshtml) or View Components if complex logic is needed. Create Pages/Shared/_ViewSwitcher.cshtml. Use <partial name="_ViewSwitcher" /> to render. For complex controls, create ViewComponent class.
issues.title: User Controls (.ascx) Not Supported in .NET 8

issues.impact: Configuration access must use dependency-injected IConfiguration.
issues.description: ConfigurationManager.AppSettings pattern is legacy and should use IConfiguration in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace ConfigurationManager with IConfiguration injected via DI. Access settings: _configuration["UseMockData"]. Or use Options pattern: builder.Services.Configure<AppSettings>(builder.Configuration.GetSection("AppSettings")); Inject IOptions<AppSettings>.
issues.title: ConfigurationManager Pattern Should Use IConfiguration

issues.impact: Application Insights configuration must be updated for ASP.NET Core.
issues.description: Microsoft.ApplicationInsights 2.9.1 packages are outdated for .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Update to Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore 2.21.0 or later for .NET 8 support. Remove Web Forms-specific Application Insights packages. Configure in Program.cs: builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry(builder.Configuration["ApplicationInsights:ConnectionString"]).
issues.title: Application Insights Packages Outdated

issues.impact: Session middleware must use ASP.NET Core built-in support.
issues.description: SessionStateModule package is Web Forms-specific and not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove package. Use built-in ASP.NET Core session middleware. Configure in Program.cs: builder.Services.AddSession(); app.UseSession();. For distributed scenarios, use IDistributedCache with Redis or SQL Server.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.SessionState.SessionStateModule Not Compatible

issues.impact: All data access must be converted to async/await pattern.
issues.description: CatalogService uses synchronous EF methods which should be async in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Convert all data access methods to async: public async Task<PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItem>> GetCatalogItemsPaginatedAsync(int pageSize, int pageIndex, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default). Use LongCountAsync(), ToListAsync(). Update all callers to await async methods.
issues.title: Synchronous Data Access Should Be Async

issues.codeSnippet: public PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItem> GetCatalogItemsPaginated(int pageSize, int pageIndex)
issues.impact: Method signatures must include CancellationToken for proper async support.
issues.description: Service methods don't accept CancellationToken which is best practice for async operations in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Add CancellationToken parameter to all async methods: public async Task<PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItem>> GetCatalogItemsPaginatedAsync(int pageSize, int pageIndex, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default). Pass to all async EF Core operations.
issues.title: Missing CancellationToken Parameters

issues.impact: Architecture must be refactored to follow clean architecture with repository pattern.
issues.description: Services directly use DbContext which violates repository pattern recommended for clean architecture.
issues.recommendation: Implement repository pattern. Create ICatalogItemRepository, ICatalogBrandRepository, ICatalogTypeRepository in Domain layer. Implement repositories in Infrastructure layer. Inject repositories into services instead of DbContext. Services should not have direct EF Core dependencies.
issues.title: DbContext Direct Usage in Service Layer

issues.impact: Project file must be completely rewritten to SDK-style format.
issues.description: The project uses old .csproj format with imports and references which must be converted to SDK-style format.
issues.recommendation: Convert to SDK-style project: <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">. Set TargetFramework to net8.0. Replace package references with PackageReference format. Remove unnecessary imports and build targets. Use dotnet new webapp as reference.
issues.title: Old-Style .csproj Format Must Migrate to SDK-Style

issues.impact: Optional migration to System.Text.Json for better performance.
issues.description: Project uses Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.1. While compatible, System.Text.Json is recommended for .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Consider migrating to System.Text.Json (built-in). If Newtonsoft.Json features are required, update to latest version (13.0.3). Add Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.NewtonsoftJson 8.0.0 if needed for API endpoints.
issues.title: Newtonsoft.Json Should Consider System.Text.Json

issues.impact: UI styling may need minor adjustments for Bootstrap 5 changes.
issues.description: Bootstrap 4.3.1 is outdated. Bootstrap 5.x is recommended for new .NET 8 projects.
issues.recommendation: Update to Bootstrap 5.3.x. Review breaking changes from Bootstrap 4 to 5. Update CSS classes (e.g., ml-/mr- to ms-/me-). Update JavaScript usage (Bootstrap 5 doesn't require jQuery). Manage via LibMan or npm.
issues.title: Bootstrap 4.3.1 Outdated

issues.impact: Services need comprehensive error handling and logging for production.
issues.description: CatalogService methods lack try-catch blocks and error logging for production readiness.
issues.recommendation: Add try-catch blocks to all service methods. Inject ILogger<CatalogService>. Log errors with context. Create custom exception types. Example: try { await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken); _logger.LogInformation("Created catalog item {Id}", catalogItem.Id); } catch (DbUpdateException ex) { _logger.LogError(ex, "Error creating catalog item"); throw; }
issues.title: Missing Error Handling and Logging in Services

issues.impact: Services need comprehensive validation for robustness.
issues.description: Services don't validate input parameters before database operations.
issues.recommendation: Add input validation. Use FluentValidation or manual validation. Example: if (catalogItem == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(catalogItem)); Validate business rules before database operations. Return result objects instead of throwing exceptions for validation failures.
issues.title: Missing Validation in Service Layer

issues.impact: Lifecycle management must be handled by DI container.
issues.description: CatalogService implements IDisposable manually which should be managed by DI container.
issues.recommendation: Remove IDisposable from service. Register service as Scoped in DI: builder.Services.AddScoped<ICatalogService, CatalogService>();. Register DbContext as Scoped. DI container will handle disposal automatically. Don't manually dispose injected dependencies.
issues.title: IDisposable Pattern in Service Should Use DI Lifetime

issues.impact: Security validation must be properly configured in ASP.NET Core.
issues.description: Edit.aspx has ValidateRequest disabled which could expose XSS vulnerabilities.
issues.recommendation: In ASP.NET Core, request validation is handled differently. Don't disable validation. Use [AllowHtml] attribute on specific properties if HTML input is needed. Implement proper input sanitization. Use AntiXssEncoder. Enable antiforgery tokens (enabled by default in Razor Pages).
issues.title: ValidateRequest=false Security Concern

issues.impact: Comprehensive test suite should be created as part of migration.
issues.description: No test projects found. Migration should include comprehensive test coverage.
issues.recommendation: Create test projects: tests/eShop.UnitTests and tests/eShop.IntegrationTests. Use xUnit, FluentAssertions, and Moq. Test service layer with mocked repositories. Test repositories with in-memory database. Test Razor Pages with WebApplicationFactory. Aim for 80%+ code coverage.
issues.title: Missing Unit Tests

recommendations: Migrate from Entity Framework 6.2.0 to Entity Framework Core 8.0.0. This is the highest priority as it's a critical blocker. Create new DbContext inheriting from Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Rewrite all entity configurations using IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Update all LINQ queries for EF Core compatibility. Implement repository pattern following clean architecture.

Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging or Serilog.AspNetCore 8.0.0. Replace all ILog references with ILogger<T>. Configure logging in Program.cs. Implement structured logging throughout application. Remove log4Net.xml configuration file.

Migrate all 7 .aspx pages to Razor Pages. Create Pages folder structure. Convert Default.aspx to Pages/Index.cshtml. Convert Catalog/*.aspx to Pages/Catalog/*.cshtml. Create PageModel classes for each page. Migrate code-behind logic to PageModel handlers. Replace server controls with HTML + Tag Helpers. Implement proper model binding and validation.

Implement clean architecture with four layers: Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and Web. Create Domain entities without EF dependencies. Implement repository interfaces in Domain. Create Application services with business logic. Implement repositories in Infrastructure. Configure DI properly. Follow separation of concerns.

Replace Autofac Web Forms integration with ASP.NET Core built-in DI. Remove Autofac.Integration.Web package. Configure services in Program.cs. Replace property injection with constructor injection. Register all services with appropriate lifetimes (Scoped, Transient, Singleton).

Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json. Move connection strings to ConnectionStrings section. Move app settings to root or structured sections. Configure all settings in Program.cs. Use Options pattern for strongly-typed configuration. Create environment-specific config files (appsettings.Development.json, appsettings.Production.json).

Convert all synchronous data access to async/await. Add CancellationToken parameters to all async methods. Update service interfaces and implementations. Update all PageModel handlers to async (OnGetAsync, OnPostAsync). Use ConfigureAwait(false) in library code.

Replace Web Forms validation controls with Data Annotations and FluentValidation. Add validation attributes to domain entities and DTOs. Implement FluentValidation validators for complex rules. Use asp-validation-for tag helpers in views. Enable client-side validation with jQuery Validation.

Migrate bundling and minification to modern approach. Use LibMan or npm for client-side libraries. Update Bootstrap from 4.3.1 to 5.3.x. Remove ScriptManager packages. Use tag helpers with asp-append-version for cache busting. Consider WebOptimizer for server-side bundling if needed.

Create comprehensive test suite. Set up xUnit test projects for unit and integration tests. Mock repositories for service layer tests. Use in-memory database for repository tests. Use WebApplicationFactory for page integration tests. Implement FluentAssertions for readable assertions. Target 80%+ code coverage.
